description: A plant manager must authorize a short production campaign using an alternate molding resin and finalize the line assignment, available quantity, qualification checks, and material-handling controls before the campaign begins.

shared_context.S1: The plant is short of its usual resin for a confirmed molded-housing order, and resin R-19 is available as a possible temporary substitute.
shared_context.S2: Lines 5 and 6 can normally mold the housing, subject to their process and maintenance conditions.
shared_context.S3: Marisol makes the binding decision on whether to authorize the campaign and what controls must be recorded.
shared_context.S4: Plant procedure requires a ten-minute readiness huddle with quality, process maintenance, materials planning, and environmental health and safety before any alternate material is run.

PF1.text: Evan obtained the customer's signed deviation waiver this morning: only resin R-19 from lot 44B may be used, and the campaign requires 20 first-off housings for dimensional inspection plus 5 tensile-test specimens; he has not attached the waiver to the production order yet.

PF2.text: Nikhil's compatibility check found that Line 6's screw coating is incompatible with R-19; Line 5 is suitable only after a 2-hour purge and screen replacement, which he confirmed during yesterday's maintenance inspection but has not entered in the work-order system.

PF3.text: Tara's inventory reconciliation shows exactly 780 kg of R-19 lot 44B available, and the approved material calculation is 0.65 kg per housing, allowing exactly 1,200 housings; she has not posted the lot reservation because the alternate-material authorization is still pending.

PF4.text: Jonas's EHS review of R-19's handling sheet requires grounded closed transfer and a hopper fill limit of 60 percent during the campaign; he received the revised sheet from the resin supplier this week but has not updated the area work instruction.

acceptance_conditions: The campaign must be authorized using resin R-19 from lot 44B.
Production must be assigned to Line 5 for exactly 1,200 housings after a 2-hour purge and screen replacement.
The qualification plan must inspect exactly 20 first-off housings and test exactly 5 tensile specimens.
Material handling must use grounded closed transfer with a hopper fill limit of exactly 60 percent.
The customer deviation waiver must be cited as justification.
The material reservation, maintenance preparation, qualification plan, and EHS handling controls must be recorded as commitments.

content_checks.C8: any(c.get('target') == 'Nikhil' and 'purge' in c.get('detail', '') and 'screen' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments) and any(c.get('target') == 'Tara' and 'reservation' in c.get('detail', '') and '44B' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c.get('target') == 'Evan' and ('waiver' in c.get('detail', '') or 'first-off' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments) and any(c.get('target') == 'Jonas' and ('grounded closed transfer' in c.get('detail', '') or 'hopper fill' in c.get('detail', '') or 'work instruction' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The waiver changes the material choice to lot 44B and changes the qualification plan to exactly 20 first-off units and 5 tensile specimens.
The compatibility finding changes the line assignment to Line 5 and adds exactly 2 hours of purge and screen preparation to the maintenance commitment.
The inventory calculation changes the campaign quantity to exactly 1,200 housings and requires reservation of lot 44B.
The revised handling sheet changes ordinary resin transfer into grounded closed transfer with an exact 60 percent hopper-fill limit and requires an EHS control commitment.
